# The HSMA Tech Stack

## Technical

## Environment Management - MiniForge


## IDE - Positron




## Early Python Sessions - CodeCompiler




## Repository Storage - GitHub




## eBooks - Quarto



## Web Application Development - Streamlit




## Administrative


### Session Delivery - Zoom

HSMA sessions are delivered on Zoom.



### Student Communication - Slack



### Material Sharing - HSMA Website

All material is shared via the HSMA website, so students will have access to all materials (with the exception of solution files) ahead of the session.

You do not have to manage the uploads of the files yourself - this will all be handled by Sammi, Dan or Jemma closer to the launch of HSMA 7.

However, you can see what the format of the sharing is likely to look at on <www.hsma.co.uk/modules>.
